entities.name: Network slice-specific authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: Authentication and authorization procedure performed for specific network slices (S-NSSAIs) using EAP framework after primary authentication completes.

entities.name: Network slice-specific re-authentication and re-authorization procedure
entities.description: Re-authentication and re-authorization procedure for network slices that can be invoked by the network at any time.

entities.name: Network slice-specific authorization revocation procedure
entities.description: Procedure to revoke authorization for specific network slices.

entities.name: Generic UE configuration update procedure
entities.description: Procedure used by AMF to update UE configuration including allowed NSSAI and rejected NSSAI.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE during registration procedure.

entities.name: REGISTRATION ACCEPT message
entities.description: Message sent by AMF during registration procedure containing NSSAI information.

entities.name: 5GMM Capability IE
entities.description: Information element indicating UE capabilities including NSSAA support.

entities.name: S-NSSAI
entities.description: Single Network Slice Selection Assistance Information identifying network slices.

entities.name: Allowed NSSAI
entities.description: Set of S-NSSAIs that are allowed for the UE after successful NSSAA.

entities.name: Pending NSSAI
entities.description: Set of S-NSSAIs for which NSSAA procedure will be performed or is ongoing.

entities.name: Rejected NSSAI
entities.description: Set of S-NSSAIs for which NSSAA procedure failed or was revoked.

entities.name: Requested NSSAI
entities.description: Set of S-NSSAIs requested by the UE during registration.

entities.name: Primary authentication completion condition
entities.description: Condition that primary authentication and key agreement procedure must be successfully completed before NSSAA.

entities.name: PDU session release
entities.description: Action to release all PDU sessions associated with S-NSSAIs for which NSSAA failed or was revoked.

relations.description: REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GMM Capability IE indicating NSSAA support
NSSAA procedure requires successful completion of primary authentication
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains pending NSSAI with S-NSSAIs for which NSSAA will be performed
REGISTRATION ACCEPT message contains allowed NSSAI with S-NSSAIs that don't require NSSAA
After NSSAA completion, AMF updates allowed and rejected NSSAI using generic UE configuration update procedure
When NSSAA fails or authorization is revoked, AMF informs SMF to release associated PDU sessions
After authorization revocation, AMF updates allowed and rejected NSSAI using generic UE configuration update procedure
UE includes requested NSSAI during registration procedure excluding S-NSSAIs from pending NSSAI
